create_TimeStepEmbedding: create a TimeStepEmbedding module with configurable dimension and max_period for sinusoidal timestep embeddings
run_TimeStepEmbedding_forward: run the TimeStepEmbedding forward pass on a batch of timesteps to get positional embeddings
create_PoseEmbedding: create a PoseEmbedding module using HarmonicEmbedding to encode pose data with configurable harmonic functions
run_PoseEmbedding_forward: run the PoseEmbedding forward pass on pose encoding tensors to get harmonic embeddings
review_embedding_classes: review the TimeStepEmbedding and PoseEmbedding classes for use in diffusion model architectures
